brief:
Israel reduced petrol prices by half a shekel per liter, according to Ma'an Wire. The decrease affects consumers across the country purchasing gasoline at pumps nationwide. Officials did not immediately announce the duration of the price reduction or factors driving the adjustment.

The move comes as global crude oil markets continue experiencing volatility, with prices fluctuating based on international supply and demand dynamics. Fuel pricing in Israel typically responds to shifts in world petroleum costs, though domestic taxes and levies also shape what consumers pay at the pump. The reduction marks a rare instance of downward pressure on fuel costs for Israeli motorists.
title: Israel cuts fuel price by half shekel per liter
